messages:
maria: Quick sync — Tessera private rollout tomorrow morning. Need final owners for: egress firewall, cert install, and on-prem installer PR review.

devon: I can take firewall rules and the egress runbook update. I need the target CIDRs from Tessera networking.

anya: I have the CIDRs (10.240.32.0/22 + 52.18.90.0/24) — sharing in DM to devon. Also: is airgap bundle upload still manual?

sam: Installer PR is #4123, awaiting one more review. pinging @julian for infra bits. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/installer/pull/4123 :eyes:

julian: On it, I can review tonight. Two quick asks: confirm cert source (customer-provided vs Redwood CA) and whether we should apply our transient NAT job for telemetry egress.

maria: Tessera will provide certs (customer-managed). Telemetry: we need a fallback to buffered file export for airgapped sites, so no NAT by default. Document that in runbook.

devon: Got it. I'll own firewall and runbook edits. Can someone drop the minimal port list here for the ops team?

anya: Minimal ports: 443 outbound to the model endpoint pool, 22 only for on-call emergency access, 123 for NTP. Example snippet:```tcp/443 -> model-pool.cust.redwood.example:443
udp/123 -> ntp.pool.org
ssh 22 -> bastion only```

sam: Thanks. Julian — I added a quick unit test for the airgap packaging. If you approve the PR I can cut the release candidate.

julian: Reviewing now. If green, I'll approve and trigger the canary.

infra-bot: deploy-canary started for tessera-private-installer v1.2.0-rc1 — build 2026-03-17T02:10:23Z :rocket:

maria: Nice. Last thing — who owns the post-cutover smoke check? Need a name to put in the runbook.

devon: I'll do smoke check (network + e2e). Anya can own cert verification.

anya: Yup, cert verification on me. Will post results in this thread when done.

maria: Perfect. If anything blocks, @sam please escalate. Otherwise we'll meet in #eng-oncall 09:15 UTC for handoff. :thumbsup:
